established: Recipe choice ambiguity is a known phenomenon in established measurement frameworks: code coverage (line/branch/path coverage aggregation), information retrieval (micro/macro/weighted averaging of precision/recall/F1), web analytics (engagement metrics across definition families). IR evidence is strongest (Stanford NLP textbook, Sokolova & Lapalme 2019, TACL 2024). (EXP-INTEL-35280397316 result.json M1-M3, audit.json B1_POSITIVE_CONTROL_PC1)

Principled resolution methods exist across fields: (1) recipe-as-question-answer binding (each recipe answers a different scientific question), (2) sensitivity reporting (report both recipes when possible), (3) micro/macro/weighted framework (IR-specific). Resolution is to state which recipe you use and justify it by the question you are answering. (EXP-INTEL-35280397316 result.json M5, audit.json B2_POSITIVE_CONTROL_PC2)

Recipe reversal is genuine, NOT an implementation artifact: under corrected implementation, per-task weighted recipe C2 TRUE (observed 0.333 > null 0.205, all 10 seeds TRUE) and canonical per-iteration recipe C2 FALSE (observed 0.333 < null 0.586, all 10 seeds FALSE).
